title: Fix the Word Frequency Counter
description: The program should count how many times each word appears in a list. Fix the bug.
actualProblem: frequency[word] += 1 tries to read frequency[word] before it exists for a new word, raising a KeyError on the very first word encountered.
explanation: Incrementing a dictionary value requires that key to already exist. Using dict.get(word, 0) supplies a default of 0 for keys seen for the first time, avoiding the KeyError.
